remarks: Welcome to The Kingswood is a beautifully maintained 55+ adult community that currently has availability for owners 21 and older, offering the best of both worlds. Step into this bright and stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bath corner unit on the 3rd floor, where natural light fills the open-concept space. Enjoy brand-new laminate flooring, gleaming stainless steel appliances, a granite top, and freshly painted interiors, move-in ready so you can settle in with ease. Plus, you'll love the convenience of an assigned parking space #1 just steps away and your own private storage unit in the lower level. Your homeowners association covers heat, AC, water, and electricity, making living here truly carefree. The Kingswood offers fantastic amenities like a fully equipped fitness center, cozy great room with a fireplace and pool table, a movie theater/business center, and a sunny courtyard patio with a grilling area-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. There's even a brand-new solar energy roof and fun monthly events to help you connect with neighbors. Located close to I-95, public transportation, downtown Stamford, Darien shops, dining, and this is the lifestyle you've been looking for. Unpack, unwind, and start enjoying your new home. Welcome to The Kingswood-where comfort meets community!
